## Biography

I am a mathematician and graduate student in Data Science and Engineering at Politecnico di Torino, passionate about bridging deep mathematical rigor with practical, data-driven AI systems. My background spans harmonic analysis, operator theory, computer vision, 3D deep learning, and reinforcement learning.

I am actively seeking opportunities in machine learning, data science, and data engineering where I can apply mathematical rigor and scalable engineering to complex real-world problems.

---
